Sentence (English): Motivation for Purchase: I started living alone and faced a major dilemma: the endless dishwashing.
Comments (English): Motivation for Purchase: I started living alone and faced a major dilemma: the endless dishwashing. Especially on weekends, when I was home all day, I'd just eat, wash, and then eat, and wash, and still, the whole day would pass. It made me realize how precious my mother is, and that's why I bought this. Pre-purchase Criteria: 1. Non-drilling () People who live in rented or studio apartments are likely to prefer non-drilling. Since there weren't many mini dishwashers that supported non-drilling, the selection was limited, so the non-drilling installation was a huge plus! 2. Size and Assembly Instructions () It's a bit large for someone living in a house with the smallest sink. It's also heavier than I thought, so it might be a bit difficult for a woman to install alone. (It took about an hour for a small woman to completely install it.) It's been a while since I installed it, so my memory might be a bit fuzzy, but as I recall, the assembly process was as follows: 1. Place the stand where you want the mini dishwasher. 2. Place the mini dishwasher body on the stand. 3. Insert the drain pipe into the back of the main unit and position it properly. 4. Plug in the cord and turn it on! It's pretty simple, right? If you have the strength, it's enough. You can do it quickly, but I don't have that much strength, so it was a bit difficult. 3. Electricity bill () It doesn't use much. I think I run it about 4-5 times a week on average, but it didn't affect the electricity bill much. It feels like it only costs about 2,000 won? I think it won't! 4. Noise () It's more noticeable than I thought. It's about the same noise as a washing machine, but I'm taking that into account when using it. 5. Cleaning power () I cut the All-in-One Pro X detergent in half, but it still left a few stains. + I found out that each tablet is for 12 people. When I put in only half, the stains were significantly reduced, and it cleaned well :) However, I recommend pre-washing dishes that have had strong odors (egg, fish, etc.) before putting them in! 6. Space () It requires a bit of Tetris, but it's very spacious for a single person and would be perfect for a two-person household. Overall, if you're looking for a no-touch mini dishwasher, I highly recommend it! Highly recommended for single- or two-person households.

Size and Assembly Instructions () It's a bit large for someone living in a house with the smallest sink. It's also heavier than I thought, so it might be a bit difficult for a woman to install alone. Place the stand where you want the mini dishwasher. 2. Place the mini dishwasher body on the stand. 3. Insert the drain pipe into the back of the main unit and position it properly. 4. Plug in the cord and turn it on! It's pretty simple, right? If you have the strength, it's enough. You can do it quickly, but I don't have that much strength, so it was a bit difficult. 3. Electricity bill () It doesn't use much. I think I run it about 4-5 times a week on average, but it didn't affect the electricity bill much. It feels like it only costs about 2,000 won? Sentence (English): *Overall rating is lowered due to install company issues.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher is good, 3rd party installers not good ] || ---------------- || *Overall rating is lowered due to install company issues. Dishwasher is 4 out of 5. First, the good: The dishwasher has an all stainless interior including the spray arms. The tines on the top rack do not fold down, but I rarely used that feature on the previous one. It is a lot noisier than our old one (Whirlpool). It came with all of the necessary accessories to install. It cleans well and no issues so far. We bought it because it had the built-in food chopper blades. Our previous model did not and the drain hoses had a lot of build-up after 5 years. The bad: Don't even bother having the installers come out unless you have all of the requirements met and nothing in the way. Their terms are so strict and narrow that it seems they are trying to get out of performing the install or generating extra revenue. For our install, they wanted $150 to replace the outlet with a GFCI outlet (I replaced it myself for less than $10). They said they couldn't turn the shutoff valve due to corrosion and that would cost $200 to replace (it looked new and I was able to turn it with my bare hand and medium force). They also said the water filtration system under the sink would have to be removed so they could access the hoses to/from the dishwasher and the cabinets would have to be drilled through since the previous hoses went under the cabinets. Needless to say, the handyman I hired to perform the install, had no issues with any of the above and was done in about 90 minutes. So, best to keep the install cost in mind for any savings you might get by buying through Costco.

Sentence (English): In January 2023 we bought this dishwasher to replace an older kitchen aid model.
Comments (English): [ DO NOT BUY THIS MODEL ] || ---------------- || In January 2023 we bought this dishwasher to replace an older kitchen aid model. I noticed right away this new dishwasher was made cheaper and was lighter. (a lot more plastic) Worked great for 2 months or so. Then all of a sudden the pump burned up and stopped working. I was able to get a replacement through Costco, no problems. Fast forward to May 2024, dishwasher isn't properly drying. no big deal. Then the plates are coming out dirty and with a film. it appears the arms aren't spinning and the pump on this dishwasher is going out. I call the costco warranty schedule an appointment, wait a week. Tech cleans out the pump filter, charges, me $225 says that if the motor is bad its not covered under warranty. Tech leaves and I run a load. exactly the same results. This dishwasher has a design flaw in the "filter" most dishwashers have a screen like filter you have to remove to clean. this one does not so of course debris could get stuck in the motor and ruin it. Costco doesn't seem to care they are selling a terrible product and a little over a year later on out over $1000.

Some other users have complained about drying issues but I think that is more the nature of this type of drying. The trade off is, you can wash almost anything without worrying about melting plastics, however, you will experience some pooling on plastics. Our prior machine required a pre-wash in the sink and with this unit we've been feeding it gunked up dishes with good results. Remember to follow the instructions and run regular cleaning cycles as well as clearing out clumps from the screens!

The door also doesn't seem to lock during the wash cycle so if you aren't aware it's running you can open it and get a face full of water. The layout of the bottom rack is disappointing. It is set up to handle two rows of large dishes. If you put any bowls or small/medium dishes in, there is lots of empty space but nothing to hold additional items. It needs another row or two of vertical tines. It isn't worth returning, but if we knew ahead of time we may have opted for a different model.

Comments (English): [ Dishwasher washes dishes. ] || ---------------- || Lots of options for washing. I like the 1 hour express wash, especially if you only have a few things that aren't that dirty. The smart features are great and I like how I can set up the wash in the app and send it to the dishwasher to start once you press OK to confirm on the dishwasher. I like the end chime and the notifications it's done. The door does open if you select that option. Everything I've put in there so far has come out clean and that's just been using the normal/express wash settings. One tip I would give is to lower the Rinse Aid setting to Low or less, I feel like my dishes were coated in too much rinse aid at Medium setting. (I could taste it in my coffee). I like the third rack, but it feels a bit tedius to load silverware one by one up there. I'm lazy and just dump them in the tray at the bottom. Overall, I'm happy with it. Sentence (English): Actually, I was wondering if I really needed a dishwasher since I am a two-person family.
Comments (English): Actually, I was wondering if I really needed a dishwasher since I am a two-person family. I also had to be more careful about maintenance than I thought. There were quite a few things that could not be used in a dishwasher. Nevertheless, I ended up buying it because the dishwasher itself seemed to have its own merits~! Even though we are a two-person family, we cook at least one meal a day at home, so the amount of dishes is not small. If I had a dishwasher, I thought I would have as much free time as the time it took to wash the dishes. When I actually used it, I intentionally did not dry it. Most of it seemed to be clean and wiped! However, even if I left it overnight with the automatic door open after washing it, the moisture did not dry 100%. Some of it had to be dried a little more on the dish drying rack! I haven't used it properly yet. I think I will be able to feel more satisfied with it later~! #EventParticipation
Comments (Original): 사실 2인 가족이라 식세기가 필요할까 싶기도하고생각보다 관리에도신경써야하고식세기 사용이 불가한 것들도 제법 있더라구요.그럼에도 구매하게 된 건식세기 자체가 주는 메리트가 있어보였어요~!2인이라고 하지만 매일 한끼 이상은집에서 밥을 해먹고있어서 설거지양이결코 적지는 않거든요.식세기가 있다면 설거지 시간만큼의 여유가 생길 것 같았구요.실제로 사용시 일부러 애벌 안하고 진행해보니대부분 깨끗하고 닦이는 것 같아요!다만 세척 후 자동문열림 상태로 밤새 두었어도물기가 100% 마르진 않았구요.일부는 다시 식기건조대에서 조금 더 말려야했어요!아직은 몇 번 제대로 사용을 안해봤지만나중에는 더 만족스러운 사용감을 느낄 수 있을 것 같아요~!#이벤트참여

Waited for the 'scheduling' button to be available on the website. After days of checking, the item showed cancelled. Logged into the chat to confirm what happened. After 45 minutes was told I had to go to the store location to order. Knowing this was because they cancelled the item and wouldn't reinstate, asked which store. Got a plethora of platitudes and no solid response.- Purchased at the store. Management was kind enough to comp delivery and haul away given experience. I noticed my card points were not reinstated, but figured I would use later on a Bravia TV as I was in the market and figured there was just a delay in reinstating. No big deal. Saved on services.- Second dishwasher arrived. Was confirmed dented. Again. Sales associate worked to get in touch with Member Rewards, but couldn't get anyone on the phone and order number we both validated kept erroring out on the automated call.- Called Rewards. This is where it all went downhill quickly.Associate explained first I used those reward points/dollars already. I did not. She admitted I did not, and began to explain since I opted for 18 month financing points did not apply. Reiterated multiple times before I could interject. Advised I'm aware of this, but I used previously earned points on the purchase and they were not refunded, was not expecting points/rewards dollars on the actual purchase. I also lost points earned post-junk dishwasher purchase. She said I used them already. Asked her on what. Could not confirm. She said I had $5 in rewards I could reinstate. Advised it was closer to $30-50. Went into each email after purchase and advised of amounts. She said I had to activate them. False. Once earned you don't have to activate. That's where they get you - send out rewards and if you don't use within 60 days they disappear (be wary of award denomination or they will disappear $5 at a time if not used). She argued. I read each email advising I did not need to act, but the reward dollars should be automatically available. She kept going on/off the call, got back on and said she can probably get points back in 7 days with no explanation. Obviously skeptical, asked for a manager. Was placed on hold 20 minutes and was told I would get a call back. As of now, no call back. If I don't get a call back today on this with points reinstated so I can still get my Bosch without paying for install, this situation is not going to end well. It's a matter of principal at this point.

Comments (English): [ I am satisfied with the product after using it for about a month. ] || ---------------- || If you buy it when it's on sale for about a month, it's about 200,000 won, and I use Prosh detergent. It doesn't work well if you put solid detergent in the detergent container. The detergent protection vinyl melts and sticks and doesn't come off. If you just throw it on the floor, it will melt on its own. You need to face the dish surface downwards or toward the center. If the surface you're washing faces outward, the oiliness stays! I recommend lemon scent over Prosh baking soda. I bought 4 boxes (various gifts) for 42,000 won at today's 0 house. One box has 30 tablets, and since it's one for 12 people, if you split it in half, you can use it for about 8 months at 60 rotations per box and 4 boxes, 240 rotations. (Detergent #1 costs about 150 won.) For the spoon container, put thick ones on both sides, and thin chopsticks in the middle (the bottom is tight). The part of the spoon that needs to be washed should be on top! Insert the spoon with the head facing upward. The Samsung 6-person dishwasher has a media cleaner, so the performance is the same.

That being said, my dishes are absolutely sparkling clean, and this machine is soooooo quiet. Huge capacity that's even bigger than my old machine. Fix that app situation and I'd be a very happy person!

Sentence (English): Our original Bosch dishwasher, SHE53TF2UC/02, was nine years old when it failed.
Comments (English): [ Our second Bosch Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Our original Bosch dishwasher, SHE53TF2UC/02, was nine years old when it failed. This appliance worked well but was probably near the end of it's service life. We decided to just get a new one. We then chose a Bosch series 500 model because it had a good rating for drying the dishes. It arrived here late Feburary and was installed on March the 1st. Although we would have preferred front panel controls, top of door controls were the only option. We only use the: Speed 60, Auto Air, Rinse Aide Cycle. Our dishes are well cleaned but the auto air , door opening, feature has become intermittant. We will address this nusience malfunction after we return from a short trip. I do not like the third drawer used to hold the sliverware. I just takes too much time to place all the items in it every time especially when one it loading dishes and silverware simultaneoulsy. Fortunately our old dishwasher was still in our garage awaiting recycle pickup when we came to this conclusion. I went out into the garage, reclaimed the long silverware tray, and placed it in the bottome drawer. It fit perfectly! I wonder how much did this fancy, not very useful third drawer add to the cost of this dishwasher? Yes a small silverware basket was supplied but was just too small to serve as the primary tray for all the items used daily. If it was available, we would have purchased a 500 model with front door controls. It does not offend me to actually see at a glance where the washer is in it's cycle. Now all we get is a red light shining on the floor no matter if it is the first cycle minute or minute 119. We are generally pleased with the appliance and its performance.

The wheel housing on the lower front rack continually fall off when rolling the rack out to load or unload the dishes. It appears the design of the lower wheel housing was created to use the same wheels on all four sides of the rack but the attachment appears backwards for the left side. So unless the rack is lifted when loaded with dishes the wheels are pushed off. Please note that a fully loaded rack with dishes is heavy making this difficult. I called customer service both at the appliance store where purchased and connected with GE warranty to solve this problem. The Warranty sent me the clips that the other wheel housing connect with but these clips do not work on the lower front side. The entire rack system appears fragile and I doubt will have the life that my previous dishwasher had. I will be returning this dishwasher within the 90 day warranty period as no viable solution has been made.

Comments (English): [ Disappointing ] || ---------------- || I had a great experience with the Best Buy installers. They treated my house with respect and did a great job installing the dishwasher. I have told my family to grasp the handle and open it from the middle. It just isn't built as well as our old one. At first I was blown away by with how good it cleaned and how quiet it was. I love how quiet it is. Then, it started smelling. There was always nasty water sitting in the filter area. I called for service. The guy who came by told me that the pump was not pumping all the dirty water out. He said he had several of these calls and the new pump he put in should take care of it. It seemed a little better but it did not totally take care of the problem. There is still water at the bottom of the filter although not as much as before. It still smells if I don't run it at least every other day. Sometimes we just don't fill it up that fast. I started running rinse cycles after a clean cycle and emptying it to at least have clean water sitting there. It has helped a little but still does not solve the problem. Overall this has been a very disappointing purchase. I bought this because of the Bosch name and reputation but the build quality is mediocre and the smell can be really bad.

Comments (English): [ Had to give up my old dishwasher--this is OK ] || ---------------- || I hated to get rid of my old dishwasher--it came with the house when we bought it 8 years ago, and was nearing 25 years of use. It was rusting on all of the shelf spikes, so it had to go. This unit is OK. Pros: (1) It is so silent to operate, I had to check back 2-3 times the first several times I used it. (2) the dishes come out nice & clean Cons: (1) The front door, and the bottom shelf, are both very hard to pull out. I'm one who fills my dishwasher as I go, opening the door several times a day. It's a real chore with this model. (2) If you need to open the door once you've started the wash, you need to press restart once you close it again, or it just sits there. Very incovenient. (3) The silverware holders are not great--either you've got the tiny slits to put each untensil in one-by-one, which gets your hands all dirty, or you flip the holders open and then the utensils just kind of sit in a couple of big bins. And the holders do not click tightly in place--they just hang loosely on a rail on the side of the rack. All in all, considering that it's probably the last dishwasher I'll ever have to buy, it's OK. I wish I could like it more, as I loved my old one, but you get what you get, I suppose.

Sentence (English): Anything we buy now a days works great until it doesn't.
Comments (English): [ Cleans well and has a ton of room! ] || ---------------- || Anything we buy now a days works great until it doesn't. The expiration date on them has become much shorter. Our last KitchenAid lasted 9 years with heavy use. After a lot of research we decided to go with this one. This one has a top rack that handles smaller items. It also has a different water jet system that proposed to wash coffee cups and travel mugs by a rolling jet bar. I thought this was a great idea, until I tried putting my coffee mugs in there. Mine would not fit. They are normal run of the mill mugs for size. I called KitchenAid to ask about it and it seems that on the little mugs 8 oz? will fit. So, I put cereal bowls, small condiment bowls & short juice glasses there. This top shelf also has area for small utensils or other items that may fall thru the lower racks that I like and put the tops to our travel mugs. Very nice! This model has a TON OF ROOM! After utilizing the top rack, I now have so much room to put other items. There is a good amount of space from the top rack to the second rack and second rack to the bottom rack. I am able to wash my stainless pots and pans in the bottom with my dinner plates and still have a lot of room left in the middle rack for the other dishes. I wash the large Instant Pot Insert on the bottom rack and it washes perfectly! It is fairly quiet, but we always run it delayed after we go to bed and can't hear it from our room. I like buying our appliances from Best Buy as we have the yearly inclusive warranty plan that covers all the things we buy in that year at one time. No individual plans to buy. Plus we get lower pricing because of our status with Best Buy.

Comments (English): [ Samsung, but a few cons ] || ---------------- || Running for a few weeks now. Love Samsung products, but a few Cons here. - Install a little tough due to almost 0 space between the back of the unit and the floor. There is nowhere for hoses and power to rest. Had to pull slack into adjacent cabinet. Other dishwashers have space or an opening near the floor on the back for hoses and power. - Not Heated Dry cycle? There is a Sanitize setting, but it adds about 32 minutes to the cycle. - The top silverware rack is useless. It takes up valuable space for the main top slide out. I removred it to allow taller cups, etc to be washed in the top slide out. - Downloadable cycles? Just add them to the washer without needing an app or Internet connection.

Sentence (English): I hated to get rid of my old dishwasher--it came with the house when we bought it 8 years ago, and was nearing 25 years of use.
Comments (English): [ Had to give up my old dishwasher--this is OK ] || ---------------- || I hated to get rid of my old dishwasher--it came with the house when we bought it 8 years ago, and was nearing 25 years of use. It was rusting on all of the shelf spikes, so it had to go. This unit is OK. Pros: (1) It is so silent to operate, I had to check back 2-3 times the first several times I used it. (2) the dishes come out nice & clean . Cons: (1) The front door, and the bottom shelf, are both very hard to pull out. I'm one who fills my dishwasher as I go, opening the door several times a day. It's a real chore with this model. (2) If you need to open the door once you've started the wash, you need to press restart once you close it again, or it just sits there. Very incovenient. (3) The silverware holders are not great--either you've got the tiny slits to put each untensil in one-by-one, which gets your hands all dirty, or you flip the holders open and then the utensils just kind of sit in a couple of big bins. And the holders do not click tightly in place--they just hang loosely on a rail on the side of the rack. All in all, considering that it's probably the last dishwasher I'll ever have to buy, it's OK. I wish I could like it more, as I loved my old one, but you get what you get, I suppose.

Sentence (English): We purchased this dishwasher for our new build in January 2023.
Comments (English): [ Leaks 15 months later ] || ---------------- || We purchased this dishwasher for our new build in January 2023. It's decently quiet in our open floorplan and the third rack for silverware is a great space saver (it does also come with a silverware basket to put on the lower shelf but I never use it). I typically run it on a 'Normal' cycle with 'Sani Rinse' and it uses a fan to dry if no other drying option is selected. This cycle does take a very long time (probably 3-4 hours) and if I don't open the door I can hear the fan running for hours after that. Dishes always come out clean, but kids plastic cups are still always wet. 3 star rating because it didn't last. We moved into our new home at the end of January, started using the appliances in February 2023 - as of May 2024 it's already leaking out of the door on both sides, left me with a huge puddle in my kitchen that leaked through to my basement. I rearranged the dishes, thinking maybe something was in the way or maybe I didn't shut it tight, reran it and it leaked all over again. Doesn't matter if it washes well if it doesn't hold water! Customer Service was not able or willing to make an exception and send service out. We bought a Whirlpool French door fridge, electric double oven and dishwasher for our new build and have now had something break on all 3 appliances with 15 months of use (we are a family of 3 and take good care of our home). Very disappointed in the quality of the brand and more than anything the customer service. Can't recommend, overall.

Then last Friday, my husband went down to our basement to find the basement rug soaked and drywall ceiling pieces on the floor.  Luckily our plumber was out within an hour or so.  He had to cut two VERY large holes in the drywall ceiling to determine it was coming from the dishwasher ($95 service fee).  Then we paid $650 to have the drywall ceiling repaired earlier this week.  Today, the actual appliance repairman came out and it's going to cost us over $500 to fix the dishwasher that is only 4 years old?!?!?!  The seal on the pump and motor assembly failed and the only way to fix it is with a whole new assembly!  At this point we will be getting a new dishwasher and it definitely will NOT be a GE. We did a major renovation 18 months ago, and replaced all of our appliances EXCEPT the dishwasher because it was so new.  That was obviously a mistake in judgment.  We will be replacing this with a Frigidaire, which is what our other new appliances are.  So this $1000 dishwasher has cost me $695 to repair the damage it did this week, plus the additional $95 for the appliance repairman diagnostic service call, and now will likely spend close to another $1000 for a new dishwasher.  I'm incredibly frustrated that this unit only last less than 4 years and likely won't be purchasing any other GE products in the future.

Comments (English): [ Dishwasher purchase increases happiness index! ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a purchase I made with my own money. Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher for 14 People [DW60BB800ULWS]. Color: Glam White. Installation method: Built-in installation. Country of manufacture: Thailand. Manufacturer/importer: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. Release date of the same model: January 2023. [Main functions]. Sterilization + drying (not 100 degree hot air drying). Automatic door opening function. Washing performance: 4-stage 3D water flow / 720 degree moving washing wing (bottom) / Wide washing wing (top) / No AI customized washing. Included high-temperature direct water washing / No water filter. Number of dish baskets: 3 EA / No internal lighting. ********( . )******* . Hello. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. There's a lot more I could explain, but this is already too long, so I'll stop here. I'm very satisfied with this product and am using it. I hope you found my review helpful! Comments (English): [ Dishwasher purchase increases happiness index! ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a purchase I made with my own money. Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher for 14 People [DW60BB800ULWS]. Color: Glam White. Installation method: Built-in installation. Country of manufacture: Thailand. Manufacturer/importer: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. Release date of the same model: January 2023. [Main functions]. Sterilization + drying (not 100 degree hot air drying). Automatic door opening function. Washing performance: 4-stage 3D water flow / 720 degree moving washing wing (bottom) / Wide washing wing (top) / No AI customized washing. Included high-temperature direct water washing / No water filter. Number of dish baskets: 3 EA / No internal lighting. ********( . )******* . Hello. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. There's a lot more I could explain, but this is already too long, so I'll stop here. I'm very satisfied with this product and am using it. I hope you found my review helpful! Sterilization + drying (not 100 degree hot air drying). Automatic door opening function. Included high-temperature direct water washing / No water filter. Number of dish baskets: 3 EA / No internal lighting. ********( . )******* . Hello. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. There's a lot more I could explain, but this is already too long, so I'll stop here. I'm very satisfied with this product and am using it. I hope you found my review helpful! Comments (English): [ Dishwasher purchase increases happiness index! ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a purchase I made with my own money. Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher for 14 People [DW60BB800ULWS]. Color: Glam White. Installation method: Built-in installation. Country of manufacture: Thailand. Manufacturer/importer: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. Release date of the same model: January 2023. [Main functions]. Sterilization + drying (not 100 degree hot air drying). Automatic door opening function. Washing performance: 4-stage 3D water flow / 720 degree moving washing wing (bottom) / Wide washing wing (top) / No AI customized washing. Included high-temperature direct water washing / No water filter. Number of dish baskets: 3 EA / No internal lighting. ********( . )******* . Hello. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. There's a lot more I could explain, but this is already too long, so I'll stop here. I'm very satisfied with this product and am using it. I hope you found my review helpful! Comments (English): [ Dishwasher purchase increases happiness index! ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a purchase I made with my own money. Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher for 14 People [DW60BB800ULWS]. Color: Glam White. Installation method: Built-in installation. Country of manufacture: Thailand. Manufacturer/importer: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. Release date of the same model: January 2023. [Main functions]. Sterilization + drying (not 100 degree hot air drying). Automatic door opening function. Washing performance: 4-stage 3D water flow / 720 degree moving washing wing (bottom) / Wide washing wing (top) / No AI customized washing. Included high-temperature direct water washing / No water filter. Number of dish baskets: 3 EA / No internal lighting. ********( . )******* . Hello. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. There's a lot more I could explain, but this is already too long, so I'll stop here. I'm very satisfied with this product and am using it. I hope you found my review helpful! This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. Sterilization + drying (not 100 degree hot air drying). Automatic door opening function. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. There's a lot more I could explain, but this is already too long, so I'll stop here. I'm very satisfied with this product and am using it. I hope you found my review helpful! First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. There's a lot more I could explain, but this is already too long, so I'll stop here. I'm very satisfied with this product and am using it. I hope you found my review helpful! Sterilization + drying (not 100 degree hot air drying). Automatic door opening function. Washing performance: 4-stage 3D water flow / 720 degree moving washing wing (bottom) / Wide washing wing (top) / No AI customized washing. Included high-temperature direct water washing / No water filter. Number of dish baskets: 3 EA / No internal lighting. ********( . )******* . Hello. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. There's a lot more I could explain, but this is already too long, so I'll stop here. I'm very satisfied with this product and am using it. I hope you found my review helpful! Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher for 14 People [DW60BB800ULWS]. Color: Glam White. Installation method: Built-in installation. Country of manufacture: Thailand. Manufacturer/importer: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. Release date of the same model: January 2023. [Main functions]. Sterilization + drying (not 100 degree hot air drying). Automatic door opening function. Washing performance: 4-stage 3D water flow / 720 degree moving washing wing (bottom) / Wide washing wing (top) / No AI customized washing. Included high-temperature direct water washing / No water filter. Number of dish baskets: 3 EA / No internal lighting. ********( . )******* . Hello. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. There's a lot more I could explain, but this is already too long, so I'll stop here. I'm very satisfied with this product and am using it. I hope you found my review helpful! Comments (English): [ Dishwasher purchase increases happiness index! ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a purchase I made with my own money. Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher for 14 People [DW60BB800ULWS]. Color: Glam White. Installation method: Built-in installation. Country of manufacture: Thailand. Manufacturer/importer: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. Release date of the same model: January 2023. [Main functions]. Sterilization + drying (not 100 degree hot air drying). Automatic door opening function. Washing performance: 4-stage 3D water flow / 720 degree moving washing wing (bottom) / Wide washing wing (top) / No AI customized washing. Included high-temperature direct water washing / No water filter. Number of dish baskets: 3 EA / No internal lighting. ********( . )******* . Hello. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. There's a lot more I could explain, but this is already too long, so I'll stop here. I'm very satisfied with this product and am using it. I hope you found my review helpful!
