Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher for 14 People [DW60BB800ULWS]. Color: Glam White. Installation method: Built-in installation. Country of manufacture: Thailand. Manufacturer/importer: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. Release date of the same model: January 2023. [Main functions]. Sterilization + drying (not 100 degree hot air drying). Automatic door opening function. Washing performance: 4-stage 3D water flow / 720 degree moving washing wing (bottom) / Wide washing wing (top) / No AI customized washing. Included high-temperature direct water washing / No water filter. Number of dish baskets: 3 EA / No internal lighting. ********( . )******* . Hello. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. There's a lot more I could explain, but this is already too long, so I'll stop here. I'm very satisfied with this product and am using it. I hope you found my review helpful! First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. There's a lot more I could explain, but this is already too long, so I'll stop here. I'm very satisfied with this product and am using it. I hope you found my review helpful! Sterilization + drying (not 100 degree hot air drying). Automatic door opening function. Washing performance: 4-stage 3D water flow / 720 degree moving washing wing (bottom) / Wide washing wing (top) / No AI customized washing. Included high-temperature direct water washing / No water filter. Number of dish baskets: 3 EA / No internal lighting. ********( . )******* . Hello. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. There's a lot more I could explain, but this is already too long, so I'll stop here. I'm very satisfied with this product and am using it. I hope you found my review helpful! Comments (English): [ Dishwasher purchase increases happiness index! ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a purchase I made with my own money. Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher for 14 People [DW60BB800ULWS]. Color: Glam White. Installation method: Built-in installation. Country of manufacture: Thailand. Manufacturer/importer: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. Release date of the same model: January 2023. [Main functions]. Sterilization + drying (not 100 degree hot air drying). Automatic door opening function. Washing performance: 4-stage 3D water flow / 720 degree moving washing wing (bottom) / Wide washing wing (top) / No AI customized washing. Included high-temperature direct water washing / No water filter. Number of dish baskets: 3 EA / No internal lighting. ********( . )******* . Hello. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. There's a lot more I could explain, but this is already too long, so I'll stop here. I'm very satisfied with this product and am using it. I hope you found my review helpful! Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher for 14 People [DW60BB800ULWS]. Color: Glam White. Installation method: Built-in installation. Country of manufacture: Thailand. Manufacturer/importer: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. Release date of the same model: January 2023. [Main functions]. Sterilization + drying (not 100 degree hot air drying). Automatic door opening function. Washing performance: 4-stage 3D water flow / 720 degree moving washing wing (bottom) / Wide washing wing (top) / No AI customized washing. Included high-temperature direct water washing / No water filter. Number of dish baskets: 3 EA / No internal lighting. ********( . )******* . Hello. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. There's a lot more I could explain, but this is already too long, so I'll stop here. I'm very satisfied with this product and am using it. I hope you found my review helpful! First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. Sterilization + drying (not 100 degree hot air drying). Automatic door opening function. Included high-temperature direct water washing / No water filter. Number of dish baskets: 3 EA / No internal lighting. ********( . )******* . Hello. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. There's a lot more I could explain, but this is already too long, so I'll stop here. I'm very satisfied with this product and am using it. I hope you found my review helpful! First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. Sterilization + drying (not 100 degree hot air drying). Automatic door opening function. Included high-temperature direct water washing / No water filter. Number of dish baskets: 3 EA / No internal lighting. ********( . )******* . Hello. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. There's a lot more I could explain, but this is already too long, so I'll stop here. I'm very satisfied with this product and am using it. I hope you found my review helpful! Comments (English): [ Dishwasher purchase increases happiness index! ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a purchase I made with my own money. Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher for 14 People [DW60BB800ULWS]. Color: Glam White. Installation method: Built-in installation. Country of manufacture: Thailand. Manufacturer/importer: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. Release date of the same model: January 2023. [Main functions]. Sterilization + drying (not 100 degree hot air drying). Automatic door opening function. Washing performance: 4-stage 3D water flow / 720 degree moving washing wing (bottom) / Wide washing wing (top) / No AI customized washing. Included high-temperature direct water washing / No water filter. Number of dish baskets: 3 EA / No internal lighting. ********( . )******* . Hello. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. There's a lot more I could explain, but this is already too long, so I'll stop here. I'm very satisfied with this product and am using it. I hope you found my review helpful! Comments (English): [ Dishwasher purchase increases happiness index! ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a purchase I made with my own money. Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher for 14 People [DW60BB800ULWS]. Color: Glam White. Installation method: Built-in installation. Country of manufacture: Thailand. Manufacturer/importer: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. Release date of the same model: January 2023. [Main functions]. Sterilization + drying (not 100 degree hot air drying). Automatic door opening function. Washing performance: 4-stage 3D water flow / 720 degree moving washing wing (bottom) / Wide washing wing (top) / No AI customized washing. Included high-temperature direct water washing / No water filter. Number of dish baskets: 3 EA / No internal lighting. ********( . )******* . Hello. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. There's a lot more I could explain, but this is already too long, so I'll stop here. I'm very satisfied with this product and am using it. I hope you found my review helpful! Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. Comments (English): [ Dishwasher purchase increases happiness index! ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a purchase I made with my own money. Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit Built-in Dishwasher for 14 People [DW60BB800ULWS]. Color: Glam White. Installation method: Built-in installation. Country of manufacture: Thailand. Manufacturer/importer: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. Release date of the same model: January 2023. [Main functions]. Sterilization + drying (not 100 degree hot air drying). Automatic door opening function. Washing performance: 4-stage 3D water flow / 720 degree moving washing wing (bottom) / Wide washing wing (top) / No AI customized washing. Included high-temperature direct water washing / No water filter. Number of dish baskets: 3 EA / No internal lighting. ********( . )******* . Hello. First of all, I often have meals with my two sons, aged 3 and 5, my husband, and my in-laws. Because of this, I had a lot of dishes to wash, and I was stuck in dishwashing hell for over five years after getting married. Then, suddenly, I received a new dishwasher, and after meticulously researching and comparing prices for over a month, I finally decided to bring my aunt in. I searched YouTube and looked at three popular brands, comparing prices daily, and finally settled on this one. I also consulted with other moms and compared their opinions. All the manufacturers had hot air dryers, and they were even more expensive. The reason I omitted this feature was because washing dishes in extremely hot water was impossible, and even without the hot air dryer, it still had the ability to wash and dry at temperatures above 75 degrees Celsius. My children had already grown out of bottles, so I didn't think this feature was absolutely necessary, so I decided to focus on cost-effectiveness. ( _). So, while comparing 12-seater models, I saw this Samsung model listed at a lower price than other 12-seater models. The 14-seater model also held 16 more dishes, which was tempting. This finally put an end to my worries. The product in question was a relatively new model, released in January 2023, and I compared its performance with that of the 14-person model. The key features upgraded from the 14-person model were the AI mode and the interior lighting for nighttime use! The only difference was the filtering and cleaning functions. I decided I could probably do without these three items. I use a Samsung washer/dryer, and I find the AI function useful in the dryer. It saves me a lot of thinking! It does everything for me. ( ). However, I thought I could choose the dishwashing mode based on the amount of dishes I had that day. I didn't really need the lighting after I finished washing the dishes at night, so I figured I could just turn it on. Regarding the purified water washing function, since I usually wash dishes with tap water instead of purified water, and since my house doesn't have groundwater, I figured it was fine. When comparing, AI is convenient! I think you can compare prices by saying things like, "I find it annoying," "It's a waste of electricity to leave the light on at night," and "I feel more secure washing with purified water." I've also seen reviews that say the dryer generates heat and can produce a slight odor. However, when comparing with other brands, I found that all of them exhibited the same symptoms and attributed it to the typical dishwasher drying process. In fact, I didn't find it particularly unpleasant (since it's not constantly next to the dishwasher). ()*:.. .:**. One difference from other brands is that Samsung takes two days to install. They first check the proper installation location, and then the installer comes the next day to quickly complete the installation. It took a total of 50 minutes + 30 minutes (-). I moved the dishwasher next to the sink to make it easier to move dishes around. While the extra cost was obvious, I planned to use it for a long time, and I knew I'd be bothered if I didn't do this every day. Ultimately, I'm satisfied with the result. It's convenient to store dishes, dispose of food waste, and remove any remaining residue before putting them away. While comparing models, I had a thought about why there was so much moisture in my previous review when there was a drying function. After using it myself, I'll tell you the result. If you wash in standard mode and don't use the separate strong drying function, there is a lot of moisture as you can see in the attached photo on the door. However, if you use the strong drying function, there is almost no moisture! (). Ultimately, I'm so happy to have escaped the dishwashing hell, and although housework hasn't completely disappeared, considering the time it takes to put away after applying detergent, rinsing, and drying, I highly recommend it to those who didn't have a dishwasher. There's a lot more I could explain, but this is already too long, so I'll stop here. I'm very satisfied with this product and am using it. I hope you found my review helpful!
